summary: Backend-only tests for the new Midtrans Snap payment endpoints (POST /api/payments/snap, POST /api/payments/notification, GET /api/payments/status/{order_id}). All 14 pytest cases pass (100%). Verified: admin-only access, plan validation (pro=149000, family=199000), live Snap call returns app.midtrans.com redirect_url and creates payment_orders (pending), notification signature verification (valid settlement activates tree.plan + sets order.status=paid; invalid signature=>403; cancel=>failed, plan unchanged), idempotency of _activate_order on replay (paid_at not overwritten), status endpoint 404 for other user / unknown order and returns {status:'paid',plan:...} without calling Midtrans when already paid. Config sanity: MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY loaded. Live Midtrans /snap was called only twice total (once pro, once family) per instructions.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py file is now ~1842 lines — recommend splitting into modules (auth, people/relations, chat, payments, trees) since it exceeds the 700-line guideline.

POST /payments/notification returns 403 on bad signature via HTTPException; Midtrans best-practice is to always 200 the webhook to avoid retries flooding. Current 403 is acceptable for security but be aware of retry storms on real bad-signature spam.

_activate_order is idempotent for order/plan state, but there is no DB-level unique constraint on payment_orders.order_id — a duplicate insert scenario would silently create two rows. Consider adding a unique index on order_id.
seed_data_creation: Per-test-module seed: 4 synthetic users (TEST_admin/editor/viewer/other) + user_sessions, 1 tree (tree_TEST_...) + 3 tree_members, plus several synthetic payment_orders (KTR-TEST-... and 2 live KTR-... created via /payments/snap). All removed in module teardown using targeted delete_many({field: {$in: [...seeded ids]}}). Verified Mongo has 0 residual TEST_ docs after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Payment endpoints are fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_payments_midtrans.py. Run with `pytest test_payments_midtrans.py -v` (parallel-safe via LoadScope). It computes signatures with MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY from /app/backend/.env and calls the LIVE production /snap ONCE per plan — do not add loops or duplicate runs unnecessarily.
